purpose: calibrate REFUSAL_DISTANCE for src/agents/analytics_assistant.py (v3.1 W7 D3-D4)
metric: cosine distance from the question to its nearest indexed document (Chroma, ONNX MiniLM)

in_scope.question: why was the delay threshold set to 2x
how many corridors are statistically slower than the network
what does the corridor audit say about IND283104AAA>IND209304AAA
why did the stream publish a stale delay label
how fast is the streaming pipeline in events per second
which hub in Aluva has high dwell
what is the order entry agent success rate
how was the champion model chosen
what leakage checks does the feature table run
why does the alert bot send only a shortlist

out_of_scope.question: what is the capital of France
how do I bake sourdough bread
who won the 2018 football world cup
what is the price of bitcoin today
write me a poem about the sea
what is the weather in Mumbai tomorrow
what is the population of Japan

first_draft_would_have_refused: how was the champion model chosen (0.5881)
limitation_found_by_the_fixed_set: these out-of-scope probes are general-knowledge questions and easy to separate. The fixed 30-question set's domain-adjacent traps land inside the in-scope range: 'How many trucks does Delhivery own?' at 0.5018 and 'What is the GST rate on road freight?' at 0.5394, closer than in-scope questions at 0.5097, 0.5310 and 0.5984. No distance threshold separates them; see P-56 and benchmarks/raw/w7_assistant_run_no_llm.json.
